app_context.name: HydroManager
app_context.vibe: Professional agronomy tool, tactile, field-optimized, high-contrast for sunlight readability. Avoids the cold clinical 'tech' look.

rules: Use generous spacing: minimum 16px (p-4) to 24px (p-6) padding inside cards to prevent text collision.
Touch targets MUST be at least 48px height (h-12) for field operability with gloves.
Mobile-first constraint: Images must not exceed 80vh.

buttons.primary: bg-[#4A5D23] text-white rounded-xl px-6 py-4 font-bold flex flex-row items-center justify-center hover:bg-[#3C4B1C] transition-colors
buttons.secondary: bg-[#F1EDE7] text-[#1B2E1C] rounded-xl px-6 py-4 font-bold border border-[#E5E0D8] hover:bg-[#E5E0D8] transition-colors
buttons.accent: bg-[#CC7753] text-white rounded-xl px-6 py-4 font-bold hover:bg-[#A66042] transition-colors

cards.base: bg-white rounded-2xl border border-[#E5E0D8] p-6 shadow-sm
cards.bento_item: bg-white rounded-3xl border border-[#E5E0D8] p-6 shadow-sm flex flex-col justify-between

inputs.text: bg-[#FAFAF7] border border-[#E5E0D8] rounded-xl px-4 py-4 text-base text-[#1B2E1C] focus:border-[#4A5D23] focus:ring-1 focus:ring-[#4A5D23] transition-all
inputs.label: text-xs tracking-wide uppercase font-bold text-[#4A5D23]

surfaces.bottom_nav: bg-white border-t border-[#E5E0D8] pb-safe pt-2 px-4 flex flex-row justify-around items-center h-20

layout_patterns.dashboard: Bento 'Control Room' Grid (grid-cols-2 for mobile data viz, e.g. pH on left, EC on right) utilizing strict tight gaps (gap-4). Everything must fill height.
layout_patterns.lists: Tall narrow lists (col-span-full) for daily task tracking. Swipe-to-complete interactions for tasks.
layout_patterns.data_viz: Gauge or thick circular progress rings for pH/EC ranges. Avoid standard bar charts for ranges. Use clear thresholds (Low/Optimal/High).

images.description: Greenhouse overview for login/onboarding screen background (use with bg-white/40 overlay)
Plant seedling image for the Crops Library header or empty states
General hydroponic greenhouse architecture for dashboard headers

technical_rules.file_extensions: Use .js files (NOT .tsx files) for components and screens as per technical constraints.
technical_rules.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute (e.g., data-testid='ph-input-field').
technical_rules.accessibility: Ensure contrast ratio of at least 4.5:1. Never rely on color alone for critical alerts (e.g. pH out of bounds).
technical_rules.icons: Use lucide-react (or lucide-react-native) for icons. Keep icon stroke-width consistent.
technical_rules.state_colors: Always explicitly define hover, focus, and active states for interactive elements.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a mobile-first UI tailored for a hybrid_fullstack setup using React JS and Tailwind CSS.
Use standard Tailwind classes from this guideline. If converting to React Native, use a framework like NativeWind to parse these classes.
Ensure the bottom navigation provides access to: Dashboard, Calendar, Crops, Reminders, and Profile.
For the daily checks (pH/EC/temp), implement forms with real-time range validation styling (e.g., red border if out of range).
Utilize Shadcn/UI primitives for interactive logic (Dialogs, Selects) but heavily customize them to match the Earthy & Organic archetype.
Do NOT use the generic 'SaaS Blue' or generic Inter font for headings.
